reason: I like the idea of catching supplier date slips before my planners find them, but sending our POs, jobs and BOMs outside the company is not something I can sign off on myself. It would need IT and management approval, and I doubt that gets done inside 30 days for a free audit.
objection: Sending our exports outside the company needs IT and management approval, and I do not know what happens to the data after they process it.
would_change_my_mind: IT and management approve a sanitized export with a written data-handling and deletion policy, and I can send only the open PO lines and jobs without any Epicor access.
